mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_tbl1 ( member_id, member_pw, member_name, member_grade, member_nickname, member_email, member_thumb, enroll_date, member_status, manner_score, trade_count ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{memberPw}, #{memberName}, 2, #{memberNickname}, #{memberEmail}, #{memberThumb}, NOW(), 0, 0, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT member_id FROM member_tbl1 WHERE member_email = #{memberEmail} LIMIT 1
SELECT member_id, member_name, member_email, enroll_date, member_grade, member_status FROM member_tbl1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS memberCount, SUM(IFNULL(member_co2, 0)) AS totalCo2 FROM member_tbl1 WHERE member_status <> 2 AND IFNULL(member_co2, 0) > 0
SELECT member_name, member_nickname, member_email, member_thumb, member_co2 AS memberCo2, enroll_date, member_status FROM member_tbl1 WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT member_pw FROM member_tbl1 WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE member_tbl1 SET member_pw = #{memberPw} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member_tbl1 SET member_thumb = #{memberThumb} WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member_tbl1 SET member_status = 2 WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_log_tbl ( member_id, log_ip, log_time, log_action, log_device, log_result, log_location, log_detail, log_alert ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{logIp}, NOW(), #{logAction}, #{logDevice}, #{logResult}, #{logLocation}, #{logDetail}, #{logAlert} )
mapper.select: SELECT log_location FROM member_log_tbl WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND log_action = '로그인' ORDER BY log_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_log_tbl WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND log_action = '로그인실패' AND log_time > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)
mapper.update: UPDATE member_tbl1 SET lock_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE), lock_reason = '로그인 3회 실패로 일시정지 되었습니다. 잠시 후 다시 시도해주세요' WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT member_thumb, member_nickname, member_co2 FROM member_tbl1 WHERE member_co2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY member_co2 DESC LIMIT 15 OFFSET 0

SELECT POINT_NO AS pointNo, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, POINT_CHANGE AS pointChange, POINT_TYPE AS pointType, POINT_REASON AS pointReason, DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdDate FROM POINT_TBL WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY POINT_NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POINT_TBL ( MEMBER_ID, POINT_CHANGE, POINT_TYPE, POINT_REASON, CREATED_DATE ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{pointChange}, #{pointType}, #{pointReason}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE member_tbl1 SET member_status = 0 WHERE member_status = 3 AND lock_until <= NOW()
